description: ฟีม's rule: the v2 home username must NEVER truncate. The old single-row header (name + upgrade badge + bell + avatar on one line) left ~84px at @393 = 6-7 Thai chars beside the fixed ~182px right cluster → any real name was single-line-clipped. Fix = Structure A: row1 is a small faded 'สวัสดีคุณ' LABEL + the tools (no long text so they never squeeze), row2 is the name at FULL 361px, bold headline, wrapping ≤2 lines (line-clamp-2 + break-words for unbroken Thai), never single-line-truncated. Teeth-proven (run-header-structure.ts, executed): a 30-char name @320 → lines 2, hClipped false, fullText true, no overflowX; mut-name-truncate (re-add white-space:nowrap+overflow:hidden) → the long name h-clips → the no-clip gate CAUGHT. Also gated: badge shows only on profile.showUpgrade (goo's boolean, UI never computes the payment rule) + hidden when paid; avatar = pictureUrl image else first-letter (onError falls back); bell → panel with a real empty state 'ยังไม่มีการแจ้งเตือน' + a hidden unread-dot slot. gate_layer=visual (geometry + DOM). verify-the-instrument: vClamped (scrollHeight>clientHeight) is unreliable for -webkit-line-clamp (false-positives); 'fully visible' proven by the real /v2 capture, not that measure. Real-route verified @ FE d229da3 (default/longname); paid/avatar-image on the real route need goo's profile wire (#179). ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-06 (มุน, on บอง's ruling): the anchor named here is not run by CI and not run by anything else, so the field was advertising a guard that does not exist — the same shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191. The rule is connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor file itself is kept and its assertions were retargeted to the post-ทาง ข design; wiring it into CI belongs to the harness-tidy batch, not to this PR. WAS: harness/run-header-structure.ts#mut-name-truncate
